verdict.rationale: Image captioning is a fair extraction-quality question for a scraping API, but the evidence pack never documents automatic captions or alt-text generation for images on a page. The closest features are adjacent and earn no credit: AI extraction via ai_query, screenshots, unblocking images with block_resources=false, and separate GPT and Gemini question endpoints.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get automatic captions for images on a page so a text-only model can reason about visual content
